children: New Delhi, Oct. 13 -- ICICI Prudential Asset Management has announced a reward for shareholders, with the country's one of the largest active mutual fund asset managers declaring an interim dividend of Rs.30 per equity share alongside its September quarter results.

On Monday, the AMC said its board of directors had approved an interim dividend of Rs.30 per equity share. The company has also fixed Wednesday, October 21, as the record date to determine shareholders eligible for the dividend. However, it has not yet announced the dividend payment date.

Investors looking to benefit from this payout must ensure they are eligible for the dividend under the applicable settlement rules. Under India's T+1 settlement cycle, shares purchased on or after the record date will not qualify for the dividend.

The company has regularly rewarded shareholders through dividend distributions, providing them with both the potential for capital appreciation and dividend income. In the first quarter of FY27, the company declared a dividend of Rs.12.40 per equity share.
Over the past 12 months, ICICI Prudential Asset Management has declared dividends amounting to Rs.27.25 per share. At the current share price of Rs.2,938.50, its dividend yield stands at 0.93%.

The company on Monday reported a 6.1% rise in profit after tax to Rs.889 crore for the September quarter of FY27, supported by higher revenue from dividend operations. The company had reported a profit of Rs.838 crore in the year-ago period.
Revenue from operations increased 16.3% to Rs.1,674 crore in July-September FY27 from Rs.1,439 crore a year earlier, the asset management firm said in a stock exchange filing.
Total expenses increased 18% to Rs.493 crore in the quarter under review from Rs.418 crore in the year-ago period.

In the first half of FY27, the company's net profit increased 14.3% to Rs.1,854 crore from Rs.1,622 crore in the year-ago period. Revenue from operations rose 17% to Rs.3,238 crore from Rs.2,770 crore a year earlier
